name: Cross-strait Cubing Exchange 2018

organisers.name: Zhuhai Cube Association（珠海市魔方协会）

information:
The 5th Cross-straiting Cubing Competition is coming! The competition aims to promote the cubers' close communication in the "Greater China area". International cubers are most welcomed to join, to make the competition more fun with us.

The competitors are limited to 300 competitors, based on a first-come-first-serve rule.
For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee. For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online, pls contact the delegate after registration. Then we will make a reservation for you and you can pay the fee by cash on-the-site. 

Please check the competition website for registration and the other information.
